name: AutoCurr
author: autocurrteam

sections.description:
Add a price to shortcode-enabled content:

[autocurr amount=”26″ currency=”EUR”]

AutoCurr uses hosting/CDN country hints, then the browser’s regional locale, to
select a supported currency. It displays the source price followed by the
converted price in parentheses. If the target matches the source, or conversion
is unavailable, the source price remains visible.

Free includes automatic conversion, supported fiat currencies and seven-day
successful rate caching. No account or API key is required by default.
AutoCurr Pro is a separate optional add-on with visual Gutenberg authoring.
Free does not require Pro or a license. There is no Free settings screen.

Product information: https://autocurr.com
Documentation: https://autocurr.com/docs/
Contact: hello@autocurr.com

External services

AutoCurr is a client for the rate services below. Publishing a shortcode enables
on-demand server-side rate requests when a supported conversion is needed and
no fresh cached result is available. No rate request is needed for identical
source and target currencies. Requests use HTTPS and identify AutoCurr and its
version in the User-Agent. Providers can see the web server’s outbound IP address;
AutoCurr does not forward the visitor’s IP address. Assets are bundled locally.

Frankfurter

Default service: Frankfurter v2, using daily reference rates from multiple sources,
not real-time trading rates. Receives the requested source and target currency codes.
No credential is required.
Website: https://frankfurter.dev/
Usage terms and privacy statement: https://frankfurter.dev/#faq
The provider publishes these statements in its FAQ rather than separate policy pages.

Open Exchange Rates (optional)

Fallback after the primary provider fails, only when the site administrator has
configured AUTOCURR_OXR_APP_ID server-side. Requests the latest USD-based rate
table and sends that account’s App ID; it does not send the visitor’s currency
pair or price. Account terms apply.
Website: https://openexchangerates.org/
Terms: https://openexchangerates.org/terms
Privacy: https://openexchangerates.org/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the AutoCurr ZIP through Plugins > Add Plugin > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate AutoCurr.
  3. Add [autocurr amount=”26″ currency=”EUR”] in a Shortcode block or other shortcode-enabled content.
  4. View the published page. JavaScript and access to the site’s REST API are needed for conversion; the source amount is rendered without JavaScript.
  5. Review the external-service terms below.
sections.faq:
What shortcode attributes are available?

amount and currency are required. Use an ungrouped numeric amount, for example
26 or 26.50, and a supported ISO currency code. Lowercase codes are normalized.
The optional class attribute accepts CSS class names. Invalid values produce
a concise validation message rather than a fabricated price.

Why does a price stay in its source currency?

The visitor may already use that currency, their location may be unresolved,
or JavaScript, REST access or a rate provider may be unavailable. A browser
language without a region does not identify a country reliably.

How often do rates refresh?

Successful rates are cached for seven days and fetched again when needed after
expiry. This is not a live trading feed. Failed lookups do not become 1:1 rates.

Does Free include a visual price editor?

No. Use shortcodes in Free. Pro adds visual inline Gutenberg authoring.
Previously saved AutoCurr inline/block content retains compatibility rendering.

Does AutoCurr track visitors?

AutoCurr has no analytics or telemetry. It does not send visitor IP addresses,
browser details, post content or monetary amounts to rate providers. It does not
call an external geolocation service. Country hints and regional browser locale
are resolved through the site’s own REST API.
